evaluation_latitude.source: Once the interpretation of a defined operation is established, the processor may evaluate any other expression that is equivalent, provided that the integrity of parentheses is not violated.
evaluation_latitude.detail: Recorded as latitude bounded by parenthesis integrity and linked to 10.1.8. No plan may assert whether the processor exercised it, and no processor-strategy oracle is admitted.

evaluation_latitude.source: It is not necessary for a processor to evaluate all of the operands of an expression, or to evaluate entirely each operand, if the value of the expression can be determined otherwise.
evaluation_latitude.detail: No short-circuit or evaluation-order requirement is created, and no plan infers whether an operand was evaluated.

The rewrite-latitude context inherited from 10.1.5 stays a permission, while the counterweight - that any expression in parentheses shall be treated as a data entity - stays a requirement under S10.1.8-001. Neither side was allowed to swallow the other.

parentheses_integrity.what_parentheses_do: They require a parenthesized expression to be treated as the data entity operand of the surrounding operation, and block rewrites that cross or violate that grouping. The source example requires B-C to be formed before the addition in A+(B-C) and forbids evaluating it as (A+B)-C.
parentheses_integrity.what_parentheses_do_not_guarantee: They create no portable observation of operand evaluation order, call count, short-circuiting, emitted implementation strategy, or floating-point reassociation artefacts.

attribution_and_limits.negatives: Planned negatives are attributed to their owning requirement or explicitly deferred to dependencies - 15.4.3.4.2 and 15.4.3.4.5, the 10.1.2 grammar, 10.1.5 interpretation, 7.5, the coarray and image-control owners, or the source-use owners.
attribution_and_limits.positive_controls: Positive controls use literal-bearing operands, direct defining-function controls, standard-defined blank padding for character comparisons, and non-associative derived values for grouping. No compiler-agreement, address, TRANSFER, assembly, undefined-read, side-effect or evaluation-path oracle appears.

nonblocking_observations.observation: The author's report contained a transcription slip reading '+20 newly accounted; 1971 already counted'. It should read +20 newly accounted and 0 already counted. The audit totals move from 1971 to 1991 accounted base units on the author's base, which is exactly +20. The integrator confirmed the same +20 delta on the integration base.

The accounting disposition correctly marks 10.1.6.3 p2 as a definition while the requirement category remains 'effect' for project counting consistency. Not blocking, but future rendered text must continue to avoid implying that the equivalence definition requires a processor action.
All facets remain pending source-only plans. The review receipt approves no fixture and no oracle.

explicit_limitations: This batch registers source accounting only. It is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it creates no test case.
All 63 facets in scope remain pending, including the four discharged delegations - discharging a delegation means a writable plan now exists, not that a program has been written or run.
The non-associative defined-extension plans are the route by which grouping becomes value-observable; until they are implemented and reviewed as fixtures, no grouping claim is established.
10.1.7 p2's undefined-status effect is recorded as not value-observable by reading the entity; no plan reads an undefined entity.
No compiler was invoked during authoring or review. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations.
